caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #94: EQUANIMITY

equanimity (noun): calmness, especially under stress.

✅ In a sentence: She faced the difficult interview with remarkable equanimity.
✅ Similar: composure, poise, calm
✅ Remember it: equa- (even) + animus (mind): an even mind.
